data.one_liner: Provides checkedYamlDecode to give detailed errors when decoding YAML with json_serializable.
data.what_it_does: Wraps json_serializable's generated fromJson to catch CheckedFromJsonException and rethrow as ParsedYamlException with source location. Works with yaml's YamlMap when anyMap:true is set.
use_when: You need precise error locations while parsing YAML into json_serializable models
You already use json_serializable and yaml for config files
avoid_when: You are not using json_serializable or yaml
Performance‑critical parsing where extra exception handling is unwanted
strengths: Maps decoding errors to exact YAML line/column
Seamlessly integrates with json_serializable's checked mode
Supports latest Dart and yaml versions
weaknesses: Adds extra dependency and exception layer
No benefit if you don't need detailed error reports
data.setup_notes: Add checked_yaml to pubspec; ensure json_serializable and build_runner are set up for code generation

alternatives.name: json_serializable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides code generation without the extra YAML error mapping layer
